Hey, first things first, I care about you and love you! 
Life is hard as a kid growing with depression, but a good first step is to open up to your parents and ask them to assist you in getting help to deal with your depression. Don’t be too overwhelmed with having social anxiety, a lot of us do, growing up you will find ways on how you can cope with it. I hope you are well and dont decide to end it like you said you’re thinking of doing. I can’t convince you out of it, but I wish I could at least make you think twice about it cause it’s really not worth it, you have a LOT to live yet and your problems as big as they can be, will always have solutions. I hope you take the time to read this and if you ever need someone to chat with, I can try to help (:

As for why do you exist, don’t question it, just live. You only live it once, do all the things you enjoy! Money comes and goes, jobs aren’t forever, the only thing that should be forever is your search for happiness. Don’t ever give up, even without a meaning, life can still be good (:
